long_biography.plain_text:
Tubergen began in public accounting at Deloitte, eventually leading its Grand Rapids office. In 1991 he left to establish RDV Corporation as a multi-generational family office serving five related families. The role combined investment management with tax, estate-planning and administrative work, giving him a long operating career across private capital.

At Ottawa Avenue Private Capital, which he founded as a registered investment adviser, he served as chief executive and chief investment officer. He also founded Buttonwood Capital Management and remains its chairman. Beyond investing, Tubergen has chaired CURE International since 2008 and represented the Orlando Magic on the NBA Board of Governors.
